instruction.sound: Here you can see some animals. Select the odd one out.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>swan_bird_calls</voice><break time='300ms'/> The white swan doesn’t match the other birds.

instruction.sound: Which dog doesn’t match the others? Select the odd one out.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>labrador_dog_barking</voice> This dog doesn’t match the grey and white dogs.

instruction.sound: Which backpack looks different to the others? Select the odd one out.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>zipper</voice> This backpack doesn’t match the blue ones.

instruction.sound: Which food doesn’t belong here? Select the odd one out.

trainers.finishSound: The Banana does not match the croissants.

instruction.sound: Which balloon doesn’t fit here? Select the odd one out.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>balloon_noisy_handling</voice><voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>balloon_pop</voice> This balloon does not match the orange balloons.
That’s it! The pizza doesn’t match the watermelons.
ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>knife_cut_cucumber</voice> Well spotted! The sliced cucumber doesn’t match the other cucumbers. You did it! You’ve found everything that didn’t match.
